scope: Add the smallest framework-neutral ASGI callable entrypoint to createCustomerAsgiComposition so a host adapter (Uvicorn, Hypercorn, ...) can call one async (scope, receive, send) function, without importing or selecting any server/framework.

change.added: app property on the frozen object returned by createCustomerAsgiComposition, plus a default JSON body decoder
behavior: createCustomerAsgiComposition now returns a frozen { asgi, router, app, close } object
app is an async (scope, receive, send) function that delegates to asgi.callFromReceive({ scope, receive, send, decodeBody })
decodeBody: empty bytes decode to {} (the http message adapter's accepted empty-body shape); non-empty bytes decode as UTF-8 JSON and must be an ordinary object, else decodeBody throws
a decodeBody throw is caught by callFromReceive's existing decode-failure path and yields the existing deterministic 400 profile events without ever calling the router/application pipeline
asgi, router and close behavior are unchanged

targeted: the factory refuses anything but exactly the four-key options object
the result is frozen and carries exactly { asgi, router, app, close }

app(scope, receive, send) decodes a JSON body and delivers it to the invariant stage of the application pipeline (allow-decision, evaluateInvariants asserts command.payload.name, INVALID/400 INVARIANT_VIOLATION on ok:false)
app treats an empty body as the accepted empty-body shape
app returns the deterministic 400 profile response for invalid JSON without calling the pipeline
a DENY outcome traverses POST /customers through asgi.call without touching the database
a wrong method or path short-circuits before the handler ever runs
close delegates to the composed PostgresCommitAdapter close
the ASGI composition module imports no ambient capability and no framework/server/runtime dependency
tests.unchanged: repository-boundary.test.mjs manifest already lists create-customer-asgi-composition.mjs; no export/file addition required, not touched
